Container.Name: Courarr
Container.Overview: Auto-updating lists for Sonarr and Radarr. Anime lists come from AniList (this season, next season, genres, tags, studios, streaming site…) and are added to Sonarr as Anime series; TV & movie lists come from TMDB (trending, new on your streaming services, networks, people, age ratings, critic scores…) and are added as Standard or Daily series. Courarr creates the Sonarr/Radarr import lists for you, can skip titles your Maintainerr rules flag, drip-feeds big lists, sends notifications, and refreshes every day at 3 AM or on demand. The first visit creates your login and walks you through connecting Sonarr, Radarr and the free TMDB/OMDb keys.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: anime anilist tmdb sonarr radarr lists import list listrr trakt seasonal simulcast maintainerr
Container.Requires: Sonarr and/or Radarr to import the lists. Anime lists need nothing else; TV & movie lists need a free TMDB API key, and score filters a free OMDb key (both entered in the web UI).
Container.Changes: ### 1.0.0 (2026-09-28) - First public release. - Anime lists (AniList) and TV & movie lists (TMDB) for Sonarr and Radarr, with the right Sonarr series type (Anime, Standard or Daily). - One-click "Add to Sonarr/Radarr", drip-feed, keep-after-drop-off, "new on my streaming services", critic & audience scores (OMDb). - Maintainerr collections ignored in every list; notifications (Discord, Telegram, ntfy, Gotify, webhook). - Login with a first-run setup guide; API key for scripts; optional feed keys.

Config.Description: Database (lists, settings, login) and caches. Keep it: everything you set up lives here.

Config.Description: User ID the app runs as.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID the app runs as.

Config.Name: Reset login
Config.Description: Forgot the password? Set to true, start the container, create a new login in the web UI, then set this back to false. Lists and settings are kept.
